newsitem.title: FRANCE: CAP just-in-time air charter beats truckers blocks.
newsitem.headline: CAP just-in-time air charter beats truckers blocks.

text.p: French charter airline, Continent Air Paris (CAP) Cargo said it had flown a consignment of just-in-time automotive components on an intra-France route earlier today, Tuesday, as shippers made contingency plans to get round road blocks set up by striking lorry drivers.

CAP Cargo's freighter-configured ATR 42, which has a capacity of five tonnes, carried the shipment, normally transported by road, between Lyon and Rouen, where it was destined for a Renault manufacturing plant, an official for the Paris-based airline official told Reuters.

"We are receiving a lot of requests for information on air cargo charters but the availability of what is our only aircraft is limited given that it also undertakes passenger charters," the official added.
CAP Cargo s ATR 42 is also used for regular, overnight cargo charters between Paris, Marseille and Corsica on behalf of French freight transport group, Calberson.
